description: This file implements a web page for changing a user's password, including form validation, show/hide password feature, and AJAX submission to update the password on the server.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines user instance number based on session variable loginuser.

methods.name: cancel_save
methods.description: Redirects the user to 'at_a_glance.php' to cancel the password change operation.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends an AJAX POST request to save the new password configuration and displays alerts based on response.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Collects form data, verifies password inputs, and initiates configuration update.
